description: Repeatedly cd-ed into subdirectories (systems/eval-harness/runs, systems) via the Bash tool and left the session working directory there, breaking the relative-path stop hook eval-turn-stop.py. Hook fired with exit 2 (file not found) because it resolved .claude/hooks/eval-turn-stop.py against the stray working directory. Controller surfaced the repeated hook errors.
correction: Stop using bare cd in Bash commands. Invoke python3/osascript with absolute paths and pass data file paths as absolute arguments, or use (cd dir && cmd) subshells so the session working directory never moves.
